phrase: full time and attention to the operation of the vehicle
note: Vehicle kinematics and an unreviewed simulator camera do not establish a human driver's attention; direct original operator and scene evidence is required.

observables.name: ego_pose
observables.description: Original frame-joined vehicle operation and path.

observables.name: ego_speed
observables.description: Original velocity magnitude for episode timing, not attention.

context_inputs.name: driver_attention_source_review
context_inputs.description: Original operator-facing evidence, visibility and independent review of the person while operating; unavailable from vehicle motion alone.

context_inputs.name: native_driving_context
context_inputs.description: Original vehicle, route, camera pose, scene and time references.

recording_needs.name: driver_reference_video
recording_needs.description: Original synchronized camera source; visual sufficiency requires review.

limitations: A scripted CARLA vehicle has no demonstrated human driver attention state.
Requested controls, kinematics and synthetic camera pixels cannot establish the legal duty.
